name: Highwayman grants 15% haste on critical strikes from behind the target only (#925)
contract: Highwayman 707744 (Ranger Dueling talent, CharacterAdvancement 6671) reads "Direct critical strikes while behind your target increase your haste by $704545s1% for $704545d, or for your next 2 attacks." It is aura 42 on 705063, whose SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL casts 704545 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE, EffectBasePoints 14 + DieSides 1 = 15, TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, DurationIndex 28 = 5000 ms; its two charges come from rev_20260921_40_ranger_dead_procs.sql), but Spell.dbc gives 707744 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so it never fired. Fixture golems are summoned with the Ranger's orientation (facing +X). The Ranger first stands 3 yd beyond front_golem facing it, so the golem faces the Ranger: white hits with fixtured hit, expertise and crit land as critical strikes from the front and must grant no haste. The Ranger then stands 3 yd behind back_golem, which faces away: the first critical white hit must put 704545 on the Ranger with amount 15. Before the fix the buff never appears.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Fixture stun, so the golems keep their spawn facing instead of turning toward the Ranger
SETUP: the front golem is stunned
Let the global cooldown pass
SETUP: the back golem is stunned
SETUP: Highwayman is active on the Ranger
SETUP: fixtured melee critical strike chance
Stand 3 yd beyond front_golem, facing it
Let the teleport complete
SETUP: the Ranger is in melee range of front_golem
White hits from the front
Let several swings land
SETUP: several white hits landed from the front
Critical strikes from the front grant no Highwayman haste
Stand 3 yd behind back_golem
Let the teleport complete
SETUP: the Ranger is in melee range of back_golem
White hits from behind
DISCRIMINATING: a critical strike from behind grants Highwayman
Highwayman increases haste by 15%
